info.title: OwnerRez API
info.description:
REST API for the OwnerRez vacation-rental platform — read and manage bookings, guests, properties, listings, messaging, and more.

## Base URL

All requests go to `https://api.ownerrez.com`. Paths are versioned under `/v2`.

## Authentication

Every request must be authenticated with one of:

- **OAuth 2.0** — send `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.
- **HTTP Basic** — your API key as the username and a blank password.

## Using an AI agent?

- [llms.txt](/llms.txt) — a compact map of the API for LLM tooling.
- [Machine-readable operation index](/help/v2/index.md) — every operation, with links to per-operation markdown.

Prefer a guided walkthrough? See the [Guides](/help/guides).

items.description: The subset of records for the current page in the collection.

allOf.description:
View model representing a discount with all its properties and criteria.
Amounts are always expressed as positive values; the system stores them as negative internally.

discount_code.description:
The discount code for code-based discounts (maximum 64 characters).
Required when Mode is Code.

is_discount_code_exclusive.description: Indicates whether this discount code should remove all other discounts when applied.

allOf.description: View model representing a fee surcharge with all its properties and criteria.

active.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is active.

amount.description: The base amount of the surcharge. Always a positive value.

amount_multiplier.description: The multiplier type for the surcharge amount (PerStay, PerNight, PerPerson, PerIncrement, etc.).

amounts.description: Tiered amount rules. On PATCH, replaces all existing tiers.

auto_generate_description.description: Indicates whether the description should be auto-generated.

category.description: The category of the surcharge (e.g., Cleaning, Pet, Administrative, etc.).

commission.description: Commission settings controlling how this surcharge is split between owner and property manager.

created_utc.description: The date and time this record was created (UTC).

criteria.description:
Value-based criteria rules. Shadows Criteria
so this endpoint can tag it with IgnoreMapAttribute without touching the base
class. AutoMapperConfigurator picks up the attribute here and registers a
destination-side ignore for Criteria, preventing AutoMapper from
touching that session-dependent lazy getter on a freshly constructed entity.

description.description: The description of the surcharge (maximum 256 characters).

expense_category_id.description: The ID of the expense category.

expense_date_type.description: The booking date type for the expense.

expense_vendor_contact_id.description: The ID of the expense vendor contact.

explanation.description: Additional explanation text displayed to guests.

increment.description: Increment settings for multiplier-based surcharges (PerIncrement or PerNightAndIncrement).

is_applicable_to_rent_only.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is applicable to rent only (when IsPercent is true).

is_expense_pre_deduct_pm.description: Indicates whether the expense should be pre-deducted from the property manager.

is_percent.description: Indicates whether the amount is a percentage of rent.

is_taxable.description: Indicates whether this surcharge is taxable.

listing_site_ids.description: Listing site IDs this surcharge applies to. Used with listing_site_scope.

listing_site_scope.description: Whether the listing site list is an inclusion or exclusion list, or all.

mode.description: The mode of the surcharge (Automatic, Optional, Manual, Code, or Offline).

place_under_tax.description:
Indicates whether this surcharge should be placed under tax line items.
Cannot be true if IsTaxable is true.

position.description: The display position/order of the surcharge (minimum 0).

property_ids.description: Property IDs this surcharge applies to. Used with property_scope.

property_scope.description: Whether the property list is an inclusion or exclusion list, or all.

season_ids.description: Season IDs this surcharge applies to. Used with season_scope.

season_scope.description: Whether the season list is an inclusion or exclusion list, or all.

show_as_rent.description: Indicates whether this surcharge should be shown as rent.

type.description:
The type of surcharge (e.g., Complex, RateAdjustment, GuestFee, CleaningFee, etc.).
Required on create. Cannot be changed after creation.

updated_utc.description: The date and time this record was last updated (UTC).

SurchargeAmountModel.description: A single tier amount rule for a surcharge.

amount.description: The amount at this threshold. Always a positive value.

threshold.description: The threshold value (e.g., nights for LengthOfStay discounts).

calculation.description: How the commission is calculated (Owner, None, All).

owner_percent.description: The owner commission percentage (0–100). Only applies when Calculation is Owner.

SurchargeIncrementModel.description:
Increment (multiplier) settings for a surcharge.
Only meaningful when AmountMultiplier is
PerIncrement or PerNightAndIncrement.
SurchargeIncrementModel.example:
A $25/night extra-guest fee after the first 2 guests, capped at 10:
{ "type": "guest", "included": 2, "cap": 10, "group_size": 1 }

cap.description:
The maximum number of increments that will be charged (null = no cap).
For example, 10 means at most 10 units are charged even if the booking has more.

group_size.description:
The multiplier group number (minimum 1). When multiple surcharges share the same
group number, they share a combined free allowance rather than each getting their own.

included.description:
The number of free increments before the surcharge kicks in (minimum 0).
For example, 2 means the first 2 guests/pets/etc. are free.

type.description:
The type of increment unit (Guest, Adult, Child, Pet).
Determines which booking count drives the per-unit charge.

quoted_utc.description: The date this quote was made.

updated_utc.description: The date this quote was last updated in the system.

check_out.description: The quoted departure checkout time in property time zone in 24 hour HH:mm format, e.g. 09:00. (NULL use property default)

departure.description: The quoted date of departure in property time zone in yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g. 2024-10-31.

discount_code.description: Optional discount code to apply to the quote.

expires_utc.description: The date this quote expires (UTC). Omit or null to use property default (QuoteExpirationDays).

generate_charges.description:
Whether to generate charges on the quote. Default is true.
For PATCH, when true, charges will be regenerated (reset).

generate_email.description: Whether to generate and send email system messages after creating the quote. Default is false.

guest_id.description: The ID of the guest this quote was created for.

hold_dates.description: Whether to create a hold block for the quoted dates. Default is false.

listing_site_id.description: The listing site this quote is attributed to. Use the Id from the listing sites endpoints.

test.description:
Indicates that the generated quote should be returned only, not stored. 
When true, the quote operation (POST/PATCH) will be validated and processed 
(including charge generation if requested) but not committed to the database.
Default is false.

validate_rules.description: Whether to validate property rules (min/max nights, etc.). Default is true.

amount.description: The nightly rate. (NULL use seasonal default)

The 3-character currency in which the amount is specified.

This field is used only for validation. The currency supplied must match the currency configured for the property in OwnerRez.

date.description: The date on which this spot rate is effective. Forms a unique key along with PropertyId.

is_arrival_disallowed.description: Disallow arrival. (NULL use season or property rule)

is_departure_disallowed.description: Disallow departure. (NULL use season or property rule)

is_gap_required.description: Only allow either arrival or departure on this day, not both. If this property is set to true, arrival and departure values will be ignored.

max_nights.description: The maximum number of nights. (NULL use season or property rule)

min_nights.description: The minimum number of nights. (NULL use season or property rule)

overrides_gap_arrival.description: Should the arrival rule apply even if there are gap rules.

overrides_gap_departure.description: Should the departure rule apply even if there are gap rules.

overrides_gap_min_nights.description: Should the minimum number of nights apply even if there are gap rules.

property_id.description: The ID of the property to which this spot rate applies. Forms a unique key along with Date.
